Skill Progression Plan: Transitioning from Traditional Sketching to Digital Illustration

Goal:
To successfully transition from traditional sketching to creating full digital illustrations by building a professional portfolio of 10 high-quality digital pieces within four months.

Timeline: 4 Months

Month 1: Foundation and Tool Mastery
- Goal: Become proficient with digital tools and understand the digital workflow.
- Milestones:
  - Select and set up digital art software (e.g., Photoshop, Procreate, Clip Studio Paint) and hardware (tablet).
  - Complete 3-5 practice sketches using digital brushes to mimic traditional media.
  - Learn layer management, basic color theory in a digital context, and non-destructive editing techniques.
- Deliverable: 2 practice pieces demonstrating basic digital techniques.

Month 2: Style Development and Composition
- Goal: Develop a consistent digital style and improve composition skills.
- Milestones:
  - Analyze favorite digital artists to identify style elements.
  - Create 3-4 pieces focusing on strong composition and lighting.
  - Experiment with different digital brushes and effects to find a personal aesthetic.
- Deliverable: 3 pieces showcasing improved composition and emerging personal style.

Month 3: Advanced Techniques and Portfolio Curation
- Goal: Refine technical skills and begin curating the final portfolio.
- Milestones:
  - Create 3-4 pieces incorporating advanced techniques (e.g., complex lighting, texture work, character design).
  - Review and critique previous works; select the best pieces for the portfolio.
  - Begin formatting pieces for portfolio presentation (resolution, file types).
- Deliverable: 3 advanced pieces and a draft selection of 8-9 portfolio pieces.

Month 4: Finalization and Portfolio Completion
- Goal: Finalize the portfolio and prepare for professional presentation.
- Milestones:
  - Complete the final 1-2 pieces to reach the target of 10.
  - Edit and polish all 10 pieces for consistency in quality and style.
  - Organize the portfolio in a professional format (PDF, website, or platform like ArtStation).
  - Gather feedback from peers or mentors and make final adjustments.
- Deliverable: A completed portfolio of 10 digital illustrations ready for submission or sharing.
